metadata.name: duel
metadata.description: Stock-vs-stock duels: tokenized shares in escrow, settled by Pyth prices

instructions.name: accept_duel
docs: Take the other side: escrow the opponent's stake on the creator's terms.

accounts.name: opponent_winnings
docs: Where the opponent would receive the creator's stake.

instructions.name: cancel_duel
docs: Take a challenge back. The creator can do it any time before someone
accepts; after the challenge expires anyone can, and the stake still
goes to the creator.

instructions.name: close_duel
docs: Reclaim a finished duel's rent. The record goes with it, which is the
creator's call to make.

instructions.name: create_duel
docs: Open a challenge and escrow the creator's stake.
The terms are all fixed here, both stakes included: the page sizes them
to equal dollars, and whoever accepts takes exactly these terms or
leaves them. `duration_secs` and `end_ts` are the two ways to end a
duel; exactly one must be set.

accounts.name: creator_winnings
docs: Where the creator would receive the other stake. Made now, on the
creator's rent, so a settlement never has to pay for it.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: The key that vouches for the handle. It is the same key that signs
prices, and it is named by the config, so a stranger's signature is
worth nothing here.

accounts.name: profile
docs: `init_if_needed` because linking again is how somebody changes handle.

instructions.name: refund_duel
docs: Both stakes back to their owners: for a void duel at once, and for a
duel stuck waiting on a price a week after it should have moved.

instructions.name: set_asset
docs: Re-point an asset's feed or source, or switch it off. Duels already
created keep what they copied; this only changes what new duels get.

instructions.name: set_fee
docs: Set the platform fee and where it is paid. Capped by `MAX_FEE_BPS`; a
raise reaches only duels created `FEE_NOTICE_SECS` from now, a cut
reaches every duel at once (see `fee.rs`).

instructions.name: set_oracle
docs: Name the key whose signed quotes price SOURCE_SIGNED stocks. Duels
copy it at creation, so this reaches only duels created afterwards.

instructions.name: settle_duel
docs: Post the end prices and pay the winner. Permissionless.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone. Pays the transaction, and the rent of any payout account a
player has closed since the duel began.

accounts.name: creator_price
docs: the end boundary. Omitted for a signed side.

instructions.name: start_duel
docs: Lock the start prices. Permissionless: the prices prove themselves.

accounts.name: creator_price
docs: receiver-owned, a fully verified PriceUpdateV2, the creator's feed, the
first price at or after the start boundary. Omitted for a signed side.

instructions.name: unlink_handle
docs: Take the name off again, and the rent back with it. The wallet alone
decides this: the oracle vouches for a handle, it does not hold it.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Which stock this token is a share of, as a 32-byte id: the Pyth feed
id for the stock where Pyth lists one, whichever source prices it. Two
issuers' tokens of the same stock share an id, which is how a duel
between them is refused.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new duels and new accepts. Never blocks a cancel, a settlement
or a refund: an admin who could freeze payouts would be a custodian.

fields.name: oracle
docs: The key whose Ed25519-signed quotes price the stocks registered with
SOURCE_SIGNED. Default (all zeros) means no signed source is usable.

fields.name: opponent
docs: Default until someone accepts.

fields.name: invitee
docs: Default means anyone holding the link may accept.

fields.name: oracle
docs: The oracle key a signed side's prices must come from, copied from the
config at creation so rotating the key cannot reach a duel in flight.
Default when both sides are Pyth.

fields.name: duration_secs
docs: Non-zero: the duel runs this long from its start price. Zero: it ends
at the fixed `end_ts` chosen at creation.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Who owns the token accounts fees are paid into.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: The rate for duels created at or after `from_ts`, in basis points.

fields.name: prior_bps
docs: The most a duel created before `from_ts` pays.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: The rate for duels created at or after `from_ts`.

fields.name: prior_bps
docs: The most a duel created before `from_ts` pays.

types.name: PricePoint
docs: One observation, as recorded on a duel.

fields.name: x_id
docs: X's numeric id for the account, which survives a change of handle.
